scenes.title: Flavor Switcher
scenes.description: Drink landing page where the background, ink and giant flavor word blend between flavors as you drag the cans.

scenes.title: Product Gallery
scenes.description: Watch product page where a full-width hero carousel and a thumbnail strip follow each other frame by frame.

scenes.title: Editorial Cards
scenes.description: Magazine picks whose landscape art slides in layers as each card moves, with section tabs that jump to a story.

scenes.title: Onboarding
scenes.description: Four intro pages whose art, title and body slide at different speeds while the background and button blend from one page color to the next.

scenes.title: Cover Flow
scenes.description: Music library with the classic 3D cover flow, mirrored reflections and momentum flicks.

scenes.title: Stories Cube
scenes.description: Full-screen stories that turn to the next person like the faces of a cube.

scenes.title: Now Showing
scenes.description: Cinema app with movie posters over a blurred backdrop that cross-fades with progress.

scenes.title: Page Turn
scenes.description: A small book of Tang poems whose pages turn around the spine, with the art on the back of each leaf.

scenes.title: Card Fan
scenes.description: A daily card draw: a hand of playing cards fanned around a pivot far below the table.

scenes.title: Date Wheel
scenes.description: An iOS-style date picker sheet: three vertical carousels turn like wheels while a month calendar follows along.

scenes.title: Weight Ruler
scenes.description: A weight log with an 801-tick ruler that only mounts the ticks near the needle, and a readout, BMI band and chart that follow it frame by frame.

scenes.title: Rolling Clock
scenes.description: A clock app where each of the six digits is its own vertical carousel, rolling forward every second, with a 12/24-hour switch and an alarms list.

scenes.title: Slot Machine
scenes.description: A three-reel slot machine: SPIN calls `next({ count })` on three vertical loop carousels with staggered durations.

scenes.title: Mood Rating
scenes.description: A daily check-in whose big face morphs continuously with the carousel's `progress`.

scenes.title: Helix Gallery
scenes.description: A photo album wound around a vertical 3D helix that keeps turning on its own.

scenes.title: Radial Ring
scenes.description: A home-screen launcher that winds eight apps around a dial; `itemAnimation` maps each item's value to an angle.

scenes.title: Map Explorer
scenes.description: Place cards that pan the city map from one spot to the next as you swipe.

scenes.title: Level Select
scenes.description: Neon level picker with 3D cards, a parallax starfield and a sliding retro grid.

scenes.title: Wallet Stack
scenes.description: Wallet of stacked cards where only each top edge peeks out, with recent transactions underneath.

scenes.title: Market Terminal
scenes.description: Trading terminal with two marquee tapes running in opposite directions, swipeable chart cards and a watchlist that follows them.
